verdict.rationale: Grok is fundamentally a chat-based assistant where all actions—creating records, invoking connectors, editing images, scheduling—are triggered via natural-language chat commands (e.g. 'create new records ... directly from chat', 'connect your tools so Grok can reach your email, files, and calendar right inside a chat'), and community reports confirm users successfully instruct it in plain language for coding and legal tasks. Missing for 10: independent benchmarking specifically on NL command parsing accuracy, and one community report (grok-comm-6) noting weaker performance specifically on agentic tool-calling reliability.
